column1: # Every point where a real key, a real account or a real published release is
# the ONLY thing standing between this plan and a full proof. Each is named
# individually with its exact substitution point. None of these is graded MET.

F29-LIMIT-01::REAL-KEY::substitution=RELEASE_TRUST_ROOT_JSON in crates/wcore-cli/src/update_trust.rs — replace the empty keys array with the real FerroxLabs release trust root (PUBLIC halves only, role release_acceptance, valid_from at or before the first release it vouches for). Produced by `wayland-release trust-root-init`. Until then ReleaseVerifier::bundled() refuses and self-update installs nothing.

F29-LIMIT-02::REAL-RELEASE::substitution=.github/workflows/release.yml must publish a `wayland-core-vX.Y.Z-release-manifest.json` asset built by `wayland-release manifest-build --sequence <n> --issued-at <unix>` and signed by `wayland-release manifest-sign --key-id <release-acceptance key>`. Measured: release v0.12.25 publishes 7 assets and none of them is a release manifest — see release-assets-have-no-manifest.txt. release.yml is fenced out of this plan.

F29-LIMIT-03::REAL-KEY::substitution=INDEX_PUBKEY_HEX in crates/wcore-cli/src/plugin/index.rs — still the all-zeros placeholder (finding F-021). This is the RUNTIME install-time trust root for third-party plugins, a different lifecycle owned by Phase 25, and it is why F29-02's plugin-and-backend clause is not graded MET. That file is read-only for this plan and gate-checked untouched.

F29-LIMIT-04::REAL-RELEASE::substitution=the ACCEPT path of `gh attestation verify` against the real Sigstore transparency log needs a real published release whose archive carries an attestation, plus a `gh` that can reach the log. This lane proved only the fail-closed paths; the accept path has never been observed by Phase 29.

F29-LIMIT-05::REAL-RELEASE::substitution=an end-to-end INSTALL of a real signed artifact — download, archive-digest binding, attestation, extraction and atomic swap — needs a published release that is NEWER than the running binary AND carries a manifest signed by a key in the bundled root. Both F29-LIMIT-01 and F29-LIMIT-02 must be satisfied first; no synthetic substitute was accepted for this.

F29-LIMIT-06::REAL-ACCOUNT::substitution=the Windows leg needs SSH access to the `seandesktop` host, which is refusing authentication on every account tried. Reported NOT ACHIEVED, blocked on a Sean-reserved credential. Nothing was faked in its place; this plan asserts no Windows result.
